messages:
Max Li: seeing a spike of 5xx + long tail timeouts for hosted inference in us-west-2. Customers reporting errors and streaming stalls.
Priya Singh: which endpoints and any trace ids? :eyes:
Max Li: mostly /v1/stream and /v1/generate. sample trace: trace=ab12-xy9; logs show gateway enqueue failing.
Elena G.: looking at metrics — ingress queue depth climbed -> 110 for a few hosts, p95 latency jumped to 2.3s, p99 to 18s. Batchers show backlog and some late ACKs.
Nate H: late ACKs? might be KV cache spinup + long sequences? do we have an influx of long-seq requests or retries?
Max Li: Customer payloads are short. There's a tenant that started large parallel warmup jobs (~120 concurrent), maybe misconfigured client retry.
sre-oncall: @Max Li @Priya please run the headroom diagnostic on one affected host and paste results.
Max Li: running now:
```
$ ./diag/headroom --host=host-47 --window=60
queue_depth: 112
batcher_backlog: 58
current_batches: 14
kv_cache_misses: 78
dequeue_err_rate: 4.2%
```
Priya Singh: that backlog and kv misses explain slow dequeue and late acks. We might be hitting continuous-batcher soft-limit + ingress token rate.
Elena G.: I see controller logs with repeated "dequeue_timeout" and "late_ack". Snippet:
```
2026-03-18T14:01:22Z controller INFO dequeue_timeout batcher=cb-12 waiting=2.1s
2026-03-18T14:01:23Z scheduler WARN late_ack host=host-47 tenant=acme parallel=120
```
Nate H: quick mitigations: 1) throttle tenant concurrency 2) temporarily increase batcher worker count 3) enable fallback to smaller model variant for that tenant. Which do we prefer now?
Max Li: can we throttle at gateway for that tenant? That would be fastest. Support has an open ticket from the tenant so we can coordinate.
sre-oncall: I'll push a soft rate cap for tenant acme to 20 concurrent requests and monitor. Pushing rollout via deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: deploy started: feature=tenant-ratecap target=host-47 rollout=canary
Priya Singh: also suggest applying immediate kv prewarm for affected hosts to reduce misses; Elena can trigger.
Elena G.: triggering prewarm with short TTL now.
Max Li: after cap -> queue depth dropped to 24, batcher_backlog -> 6, p99 latency down to 3.2s. Customer still seeing some 5xx but decreasing.
Nate H: follow-ups: add a safeguard in controller to detect sustained kv-miss spikes and automatically apply short backpressure to new tenants; create an eval for longseq warmup patterns.
Priya Singh: filing follow-up issue and runbook update. I'll assign owners.
Max Li: thanks. I'll update customer and close once all 5xx gone. :thumbsup:
